import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    outputs = []
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    for head in range(heads):
        start = head * head_width
        end = start + head_width
        qh = q[..., start:end]
        kh = k[..., start:end]
        vh = v[..., start:end]

        def query_step(carry, i):
            m, denom, acc = carry
            qi = qh[:, i, :]
            keys = kh[:, :i + 1, :]
            vals = vh[:, :i + 1, :]
            scores = jnp.einsum('bd,btd->bt', qi, keys) / scale
            row_max = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1)
            weights = jnp.exp(scores - row_max[:, None])
            row_sum = jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1)
            row_out = jnp.einsum('bt,btd->bd', weights, vals) / row_sum[:, None]
            return carry, row_out

        init = (jnp.zeros((batch,), x.dtype), jnp.zeros((batch,), x.dtype), jnp.zeros((batch, head_width), x.dtype))
        _, head_out = jax.lax.scan(query_step, init, jnp.arange(seq))
        outputs.append(jnp.transpose(head_out, (1, 0, 2)))
    return jnp.concatenate(outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

    k = jnp.pad(k, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, pad), (0, 0)))
    v = jnp.pad(v, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, pad), (0, 0)))
    positions = jnp.arange(padded)

        rows = start + jnp.arange(block)
        m = jnp.full((batch, heads, block), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype)
        den = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, block), dtype=x.dtype)
        num = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, block, head_width), dtype=x.dtype)

            kj = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(k, (0, 0, col, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
            vj = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(v, (0, 0, col, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
            cols = col + jnp.arange(block)

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    positions = jnp.arange(seq)
    scale = jnp.float32(1.0) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))

    def row_step(carry, i):
        qi = q[i]
        # Dynamic prefix bounds the work and the key/value memory traffic for this row.
        ki = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(k, (0, 0, 0, 0), (seq, batch, heads, head_width))
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,tbhd->bht', qi, ki) * scale
        valid = positions <= i
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], scores, -jnp.inf)
        top = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - top)
        weights = weights / jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        vi = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(v, (0, 0, 0, 0), (seq, batch, heads, head_width))
        out = jnp.einsum('bht,tbhd->bhd', weights, vi)
        return carry, out

    _, rows = jax.lax.scan(row_step, (), jnp.arange(seq))
    merged = rows.transpose(1, 0, 2, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return merged @ w_out

import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    qkv = x @ w_qkv
    q, k, v = jnp.split(qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)

    block = 64
    padded = ((seq + block - 1) // block) * block
    q = jnp.pad(q, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, padded - seq), (0, 0)))
    k = jnp.pad(k, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, padded - seq), (0, 0)))
    v = jnp.pad(v, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, padded - seq), (0, 0)))
    positions = jnp.arange(padded)
    neg_inf = jnp.float32(-jnp.inf)
    scale = jnp.float32(1.0 / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width)))

    def attend_block(i, carry):
        m, denom, acc = carry
        start = i * block
        qi = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(q, (0, 0, start, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
        qpos = positions[start:start + block]

        def key_block(j, inner):
            m, denom, acc = inner
            kstart = j * block
            kj = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(k, (0, 0, kstart, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
            vj = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(v, (0, 0, kstart, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
            kpos = positions[kstart:kstart + block]
            scores = jnp.einsum('bhid,bhjd->bhij', qi, kj) * scale
            valid = (qpos[:, None] >= kpos[None, :]) & (qpos[:, None] < seq) & (kpos[None, :] < seq)
            scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :, :], scores, neg_inf)
            block_m = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1)
            new_m = jnp.maximum(m, block_m)
            old_scale = jnp.exp(m - new_m)
            probs = jnp.exp(scores - new_m[..., None])
            denom = denom * old_scale + jnp.sum(probs, axis=-1)
            acc = acc * old_scale[..., None] + jnp.einsum('bhij,bhjd->bhid', probs, vj)
            return new_m, denom, acc

        m, denom, acc = jax.lax.fori_loop(0, padded // block, key_block, (m, denom, acc))
        return m, denom, acc

    init = (jnp.full((batch, heads, padded), neg_inf, dtype=x.dtype),
            jnp.zeros((batch, heads, padded), dtype=x.dtype),
            jnp.zeros((batch, heads, padded, head_width), dtype=x.dtype))
    _, denom, acc = jax.lax.fori_loop(0, padded // block, attend_block, init)
    out = (acc / denom[..., None])[:, :, :seq, :]
    out = out.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return out @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    qkv = x @ w_qkv
    q = qkv[..., :width].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = qkv[..., width:2 * width].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = qkv[..., 2 * width:].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    q = q / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))

    # Process keys in fixed-size blocks. The online max/sum recurrence computes
    # softmax-weighted values while avoiding a full sequence-by-sequence matrix.
    block = 32
    padded = ((seq + block - 1) // block) * block
    k = jnp.pad(k, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, padded - seq), (0, 0)))
    v = jnp.pad(v, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, padded - seq), (0, 0)))
    qidx = jnp.arange(seq)
    init_m = jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype)
    init_l = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype)
    init_o = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype)

    def step(carry, block_idx):
        m, l, o = carry
        start = block_idx * block
        kb = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(k, (0, 0, start, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
        vb = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(v, (0, 0, start, 0), (batch, heads, block, head_width))
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhqd,bhkd->bhqk', q, kb)
        kidx = start + jnp.arange(block)
        valid = (kidx[None, :] <= qidx[:, None]) & (kidx[None, :] < seq)
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :, :], scores, -jnp.inf)
        bm = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1)
        nm = jnp.maximum(m, bm)
        old_scale = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(m), jnp.exp(m - nm), 0.0)
        p = jnp.exp(scores - nm[..., None])
        nl = l * old_scale + jnp.sum(p, axis=-1)
        no = o * old_scale[..., None] + jnp.einsum('bhqk,bhkd->bhqd', p, vb)
        return (nm, nl, no), None

    (m, l, out), _ = jax.lax.scan(step, (init_m, init_l, init_o), jnp.arange(padded // block))
    out = (out / l[..., None]).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return out @ w_out

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    outputs = []
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    for h in range(heads):
        part = slice(h * head_width, (h + 1) * head_width)
        qh = q[..., part]
        kh = k[..., part]
        vh = v[..., part]
        rows = []
        for i in range(seq):
            scores = jnp.sum(qh[:, i:i + 1, :] * kh[:, :i + 1, :], axis=-1) / scale
            largest = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
            weights = weights / jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            out = jnp.sum(weights[..., None] * vh[:, :i + 1, :], axis=1)
            rows.append(out)
        outputs.append(jnp.stack(rows, axis=1))
    return jnp.concatenate(outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(1, 0, 2, 3)
    positions = jnp.arange(seq)
    key_positions = jnp.arange(seq)

    def row_step(carry, i):
        qi = carry[0][i]
        valid = key_positions <= i
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,kbhd->bhk', qi, carry[1]) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], scores, -jnp.inf)
        maximum = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - maximum)
        weights = weights / jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,kbhd->bhd', weights, carry[2])
        return carry, out

    carry = (q, k, v)
    _, rows = jax.lax.scan(row_step, carry, positions)
    attended = rows.transpose(1, 0, 2, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        start = head * head_width
        end = start + head_width
        qh = q[..., start:end]
        kh = k[..., start:end]
        vh = v[..., start:end]
        keys = jnp.swapaxes(kh, 1, 2)
        scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
        initial_max = jnp.full((batch, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype)
        initial_sum = jnp.zeros((batch, seq), dtype=x.dtype)
        initial_out = jnp.zeros((batch, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype)

        def step(carry, i):
            running_max, running_sum, running_out = carry
            key = jax.lax.dynamic_slice_in_dim(keys, i, 1, axis=2)
            value = jax.lax.dynamic_slice_in_dim(vh, i, 1, axis=1)
            score = jnp.sum(qh * jnp.swapaxes(key, 1, 2), axis=-1) / scale
            valid = jnp.arange(seq) >= i
            score = jnp.where(valid[None, :], score, -jnp.inf)
            new_max = jnp.maximum(running_max, score)
            old_factor = jnp.exp(running_max - new_max)
            key_factor = jnp.exp(score - new_max)
            new_sum = running_sum * old_factor + key_factor
            new_out = running_out * old_factor[..., None] + key_factor[..., None] * value
            return (new_max, new_sum, new_out), None

        (_, denom, accum), _ = jax.lax.scan(step, (initial_max, initial_sum, initial_out), jnp.arange(seq))
        outputs.append(accum / denom[..., None])
    return jnp.concatenate(outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

reference_jax_source:
def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

reference_jax_source:
def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    qkv = x @ w_qkv
    q = qkv[..., :width].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = qkv[..., width:2 * width].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = qkv[..., 2 * width:].reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    # Multiplication by the scaled identity on the left retains only key column 0.
    key0_score = jnp.sum(q * k[:, :, :1, :], axis=-1, keepdims=True) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    cols = jnp.arange(seq)[None, None, None, :]
    rows = jnp.arange(seq)[None, None, :, None]
    scores = jnp.broadcast_to(jnp.zeros((1, 1, seq, seq), dtype=x.dtype), (batch, heads, seq, seq))
    scores = scores.at[..., :1].set(key0_score)
    scores = jnp.where(cols > rows, -jnp.inf, scores)
    largest = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
    weights = weights / jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    out = jnp.einsum('bhts,bhsd->bhtd', weights, v)
    out = out.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return out @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2)) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)

    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    indices = jnp.arange(seq)
    initial = (
        jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype),
    )

    def add_key(state, i):
        running_max, normalizer, weighted = state
        key = k[:, :, i, :]
        value = v[:, :, i, :]
        scores = jnp.sum(q * key[:, :, None, :], axis=-1) / scale
        valid = indices >= i
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], -jnp.inf, scores)
        new_max = jnp.maximum(running_max, scores)
        old_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(running_max), jnp.exp(running_max - new_max), 0.0)
        add_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(scores), jnp.exp(scores - new_max), 0.0)
        new_normalizer = normalizer * old_factor + add_factor
        new_weighted = weighted * old_factor[..., None] + add_factor[..., None] * value[:, :, None, :]
        return (new_max, new_normalizer, new_weighted), None

    (running_max, normalizer, weighted), _ = jax.lax.scan(add_key, initial, jnp.arange(seq))
    attended = weighted / normalizer[..., None]
    attended = attended.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    rows = []
    for i in range(seq):
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,bhkd->bhk', q[:, :, i, :], k[:, :, :i + 1, :]) / scale
        weights = jax_softmax(scores)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,bhkd->bhd', weights, v[:, :, :i + 1, :])
        rows.append(out)
    attended = jnp.stack(rows, axis=2).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

def jax_softmax(x):
    maximum = jnp.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp = jnp.exp(x - maximum)
    return exp / jnp.sum(exp, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)

    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    indices = jnp.arange(seq)
    initial = (
        jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype),
    )

    def add_key(state, i):
        running_max, normalizer, weighted = state
        key = k[:, :, i, :]
        value = v[:, :, i, :]
        scores = jnp.sum(q * key[:, :, None, :], axis=-1) / scale
        valid = indices >= i
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], -jnp.inf, scores)
        new_max = jnp.maximum(running_max, scores)
        old_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(running_max), jnp.exp(running_max - new_max), 0.0)
        add_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(scores), jnp.exp(scores - new_max), 0.0)
        new_normalizer = normalizer * old_factor + add_factor
        new_weighted = weighted * old_factor[..., None] + add_factor[..., None] * value[:, :, None, :]
        return (new_max, new_normalizer, new_weighted), None

    (running_max, normalizer, weighted), _ = jax.lax.scan(add_key, initial, jnp.arange(seq))
    attended = weighted / normalizer[..., None]
    attended = attended.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    rows = []
    for i in range(seq):
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,bhkd->bhk', q[:, :, i, :], k[:, :, :i + 1, :]) / scale
        weights = jax_softmax(scores)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,bhkd->bhd', weights, v[:, :, :i + 1, :])
        rows.append(out)
    attended = jnp.stack(rows, axis=2).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

def jax_softmax(x):
    maximum = jnp.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp = jnp.exp(x - maximum)
    return exp / jnp.sum(exp, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)

    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    indices = jnp.arange(seq)
    initial = (
        jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype),
    )

    def add_key(state, i):
        running_max, normalizer, weighted = state
        key = k[:, :, i, :]
        value = v[:, :, i, :]
        scores = jnp.sum(q * key[:, :, None, :], axis=-1) / scale
        valid = indices >= i

    attended = weighted / normalizer[..., None]
    attended = attended.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):

    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    rows = []
    for i in range(seq):
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,bhkd->bhk', q[:, :, i, :], k[:, :, :i + 1, :]) / scale
        weights = jax_softmax(scores)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,bhkd->bhd', weights, v[:, :, :i + 1, :])

    return attended @ w_out

    maximum = jnp.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp = jnp.exp(x - maximum)
    return exp / jnp.sum(exp, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)

    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    indices = jnp.arange(seq)
    initial = (
        jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype),
    )

    def add_key(state, i):
        running_max, normalizer, weighted = state
        key = k[:, :, i, :]
        value = v[:, :, i, :]
        scores = jnp.sum(q * key[:, :, None, :], axis=-1) / scale
        valid = indices >= i
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], -jnp.inf, scores)
        new_max = jnp.maximum(running_max, scores)
        old_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(running_max), jnp.exp(running_max - new_max), 0.0)
        add_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(scores), jnp.exp(scores - new_max), 0.0)
        new_normalizer = normalizer * old_factor + add_factor
        new_weighted = weighted * old_factor[..., None] + add_factor[..., None] * value[:, :, None, :]
        return (new_max, new_normalizer, new_weighted), None

    (running_max, normalizer, weighted), _ = jax.lax.scan(add_key, initial, jnp.arange(seq))
    attended = weighted / normalizer[..., None]
    attended = attended.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

        weights = jax_softmax(scores)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,bhkd->bhd', weights, v[:, :, :i + 1, :])

    maximum = jnp.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp = jnp.exp(x - maximum)

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)

    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    indices = jnp.arange(seq)
    initial = (
        jnp.full((batch, heads, seq), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq), dtype=x.dtype),
        jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, head_width), dtype=x.dtype),
    )

    def add_key(state, i):
        running_max, normalizer, weighted = state
        key = k[:, :, i, :]
        value = v[:, :, i, :]
        scores = jnp.sum(q * key[:, :, None, :], axis=-1) / scale
        valid = indices >= i
        scores = jnp.where(valid[None, None, :], -jnp.inf, scores)
        new_max = jnp.maximum(running_max, scores)
        old_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(running_max), jnp.exp(running_max - new_max), 0.0)
        add_factor = jnp.where(jnp.isfinite(scores), jnp.exp(scores - new_max), 0.0)
        new_normalizer = normalizer * old_factor + add_factor
        new_weighted = weighted * old_factor[..., None] + add_factor[..., None] * value[:, :, None, :]
        return (new_max, new_normalizer, new_weighted), None

    (running_max, normalizer, weighted), _ = jax.lax.scan(add_key, initial, jnp.arange(seq))
    attended = weighted / normalizer[..., None]
    attended = attended.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):

    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, head_width).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    scale = jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    rows = []
    for i in range(seq):
        scores = jnp.einsum('bhd,bhkd->bhk', q[:, :, i, :], k[:, :, :i + 1, :]) / scale
        weights = jax_softmax(scores)
        out = jnp.einsum('bhk,bhkd->bhd', weights, v[:, :, :i + 1, :])
        rows.append(out)
    attended = jnp.stack(rows, axis=2).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return attended @ w_out

def jax_softmax(x):
    maximum = jnp.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exp = jnp.exp(x - maximum)
    return exp / jnp.sum(exp, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

def candidate(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    d = width // heads
    block = 64
    qkv = x @ w_qkv
    q, k, v = jnp.split(qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    q = q.reshape(batch, seq, heads, d).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    k = k.reshape(batch, seq, heads, d).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    v = v.reshape(batch, seq, heads, d).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
    qidx = jnp.arange(seq)
    starts = jnp.arange(seq // block) * block
    init_m = jnp.full((batch, heads, seq, 1), -jnp.inf, dtype=x.dtype)
    init_l = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, 1), dtype=x.dtype)
    init_a = jnp.zeros((batch, heads, seq, d), dtype=x.dtype)
    def step(state, start):
        m, l, a = state
        kk = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(k, (0, 0, start, 0), (batch, heads, block, d))
        vv = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(v, (0, 0, start, 0), (batch, heads, block, d))
        scores = (q @ jnp.swapaxes(kk, -1, -2)) * (1.0 / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(d)))
        kidx = start + jnp.arange(block)
        scores = jnp.where(kidx[None, None, None, :] <= qidx[None, None, :, None], scores, -jnp.inf)
        bm = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        nm = jnp.maximum(m, bm)
        alpha = jnp.exp(m - nm)
        p = jnp.exp(scores - nm)
        l = alpha * l + jnp.sum(p, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        a = alpha * a + p @ vv
        return (nm, l, a), None
    (m, l, a), _ = jax.lax.scan(step, (init_m, init_l, init_a), starts)
    out = (a / l).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(batch, seq, width)
    return out @ w_out

def causal_self_attention(x, w_qkv, w_out):
    batch, seq, width = x.shape
    heads = 8
    head_width = width // heads
    q, k, v = jnp.split(x @ w_qkv, 3, axis=-1)
    future = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((seq, seq), dtype=bool), k=1)
    scale = jnp.eye(seq, dtype=x.dtype) / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(head_width))
    head_outputs = []
    for head in range(heads):
        part = slice(head * head_width, (head + 1) * head_width)
        scores = scale @ (q[..., part] @ jnp.swapaxes(k[..., part], -1, -2))
        scores = jnp.where(future, -jnp.inf, scores)
        largest = jnp.sort(scores, axis=-1)[..., -1:]
        weights = jnp.exp(scores - largest)
        weights = weights / (weights @ jnp.ones((seq, seq), x.dtype))
        head_outputs.append(weights @ v[..., part])
    return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1) @ w_out

def embed_and_transform(token_ids, table, gamma, beta, w_in, w_out):
    vocabulary = table.shape[0]
    tokens = jax.nn.one_hot(token_ids, vocabulary, dtype=table.dtype) @ table
    centered = tokens - jnp.mean(tokens, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    spread = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(centered**2, axis=-1) + 1e-5)
    normalized = jnp.linalg.solve(jnp.diag(spread), centered) * gamma + beta
    hidden = jax.lax.map(lambda row: jax.nn.gelu(row @ w_in) @ w_out, normalized)
    return tokens + hidden

def embed_and_transform(token_ids, table, gamma, beta, w_in, w_out):
    vocabulary = table.shape[0]
    tokens = jax.nn.one_hot(token_ids, vocabulary, dtype=table.dtype) @ table
    centered = tokens - jnp.mean(tokens, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    spread = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(centered**2, axis=-1) + 1e-5)
    normalized = jnp.linalg.solve(jnp.diag(spread), centered) * gamma + beta
    hidden = jax.lax.map(lambda row: jax.nn.gelu(row @ w_in) @ w_out, normalized)
    return tokens + hidden

    normalized = centered / spread * gamma + beta

        activation = jax.nn.gelu(normalized @ wi)

def embed_and_transform(token_ids, table, gamma, beta, w_in, w_out):
    vocabulary = table.shape[0]
    tokens = jax.nn.one_hot(token_ids, vocabulary, dtype=table.dtype) @ table
    centered = tokens - jnp.mean(tokens, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    spread = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(centered**2, axis=-1) + 1e-5)
    normalized = jnp.linalg.solve(jnp.diag(spread), centered) * gamma + beta
    hidden = jax.lax.map(lambda row: jax.nn.gelu(row @ w_in) @ w_out, normalized)
    return tokens + hidden

def embed_and_transform(token_ids, table, gamma, beta, w_in, w_out):
    vocabulary = table.shape[0]
    tokens = jax.nn.one_hot(token_ids, vocabulary, dtype=table.dtype) @ table
    centered = tokens - jnp.mean(tokens, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    spread = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(centered**2, axis=-1) + 1e-5)
    normalized = jnp.linalg.solve(jnp.diag(spread), centered) * gamma + beta
    hidden = jax.lax.map(lambda row: jax.nn.gelu(row @ w_in) @ w_out, normalized)
    return tokens + hidden

def candidate(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    radius = 16
    kernel = jnp.ones((1, 1, 33), dtype=signals.dtype)
    x = signals[:, None, :]
    sums = jax.lax.conv_general_dilated(
        x, kernel, window_strides=(1,), padding=((radius, radius),),
        dimension_numbers=('NCH', 'OIH', 'NCH'))[:, 0, :]
    counts = jax.lax.conv_general_dilated(
        jnp.ones((1, 1, length), dtype=signals.dtype), kernel,
        window_strides=(1,), padding=((radius, radius),),
        dimension_numbers=('NCH', 'OIH', 'NCH'))[0, 0, :]
    # Apply the same local sum operator to squared values, independently per row.
    square_sums = jax.lax.conv_general_dilated(
        (signals * signals)[:, None, :], kernel, window_strides=(1,),
        padding=((radius, radius),), dimension_numbers=('NCH', 'OIH', 'NCH'))[:, 0, :]
    mean = sums / counts[None, :]
    square_mean = square_sums / counts[None, :]
    std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(square_mean - mean * mean, 0.0) + 1e-6)
    standardized = (signals - mean) / std
    peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return standardized / peak

def candidate(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    radius = window // 2
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    lo = jnp.maximum(index - radius, 0)
    hi = jnp.minimum(index + radius + 1, length)
    counts = (hi - lo).astype(signals.dtype)

    def standardize(signal):
        zero = jnp.zeros((1,), dtype=signal.dtype)
        prefix = jnp.concatenate((zero, jnp.cumsum(signal)))
        prefix_sq = jnp.concatenate((zero, jnp.cumsum(signal * signal)))
        sums = prefix[hi] - prefix[lo]
        sums_sq = prefix_sq[hi] - prefix_sq[lo]
        mean = sums / counts
        mean_sq = sums_sq / counts
        std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(mean_sq - mean * mean, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - mean) / std
        peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized))
        return standardized / peak

    return jax.vmap(standardize)(signals)

    length = signals.shape[-1]

def candidate(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    offsets = jnp.arange(-16, 17)
    indices = jnp.arange(length)[:, None] + offsets[None, :]
    valid = (indices >= 0) & (indices < length)
    clipped = jnp.clip(indices, 0, length - 1)
    counts = jnp.sum(valid, axis=1).astype(signals.dtype)

    def standardize(signal):
        values = signal[clipped]
        mask = valid.astype(signal.dtype)
        local_mean = jnp.sum(values * mask, axis=1) / counts
        local_square = jnp.sum((values * values) * mask, axis=1) / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean * local_mean, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized))
        return standardized / peak

    return jax.vmap(standardize)(signals)

    length = signals.shape[-1]
    positions = jnp.arange(length)
    initial = (jnp.zeros_like(signals), jnp.zeros_like(signals), jnp.zeros((length,), dtype=signals.dtype))

    def add_offset(carry, offset):

        indices = positions + offset

        values = signals[:, jnp.clip(indices, 0, length - 1)]
        total = total + values * valid[None, :]
        total_sq = total_sq + (values * values) * valid[None, :]
        counts = counts + valid.astype(signals.dtype)
        return (total, total_sq, counts), None

    (total, total_sq, counts), _ = jax.lax.scan(add_offset, initial, jnp.arange(-16, 17))
    mean = total / counts[None, :]
    square = total_sq / counts[None, :]
    std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(square - mean * mean, 0.0) + 1e-6)
    standardized = (signals - mean) / std
    peak = jax.lax.reduce(jnp.abs(standardized), jnp.array(0, dtype=signals.dtype), jax.lax.max, dimensions=(1,))[:, None]
    return standardized / peak

    total = jnp.zeros_like(signals)

def candidate(signals):
    import jax
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    tile = 256
    half = 16
    padded = jnp.pad(signals, ((0, 0), (half, half)))
    padded_sq = padded * padded
    starts = jnp.arange(0, length, tile)

    def process(start):
        width = jnp.minimum(tile, length - start)
        x = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(padded, (0, start), (signals.shape[0], tile + 2 * half))
        x2 = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(padded_sq, (0, start), (signals.shape[0], tile + 2 * half))
        p = jnp.concatenate((jnp.zeros((signals.shape[0], 1), signals.dtype), jnp.cumsum(x, axis=1)), axis=1)
        p2 = jnp.concatenate((jnp.zeros((signals.shape[0], 1), signals.dtype), jnp.cumsum(x2, axis=1)), axis=1)
        offsets = jnp.arange(tile) + half
        sums = p[:, offsets + half + 1] - p[:, offsets - half]
        sums2 = p2[:, offsets + half + 1] - p2[:, offsets - half]
        pos = start + jnp.arange(tile)
        counts = (jnp.minimum(pos + half + 1, length) - jnp.maximum(pos - half, 0)).astype(signals.dtype)
        means = sums / counts[None, :]
        squares = sums2 / counts[None, :]
        vals = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(signals, (0, start), (signals.shape[0], tile))
        std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(squares - means * means, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        return (vals - means) / std

    standardized = jax.lax.map(process, starts)
    standardized = jnp.transpose(standardized, (1, 0, 2)).reshape(signals.shape)
    peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return standardized / peak

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

    length = signals.shape[-1]
    tile = 256
    half = 16
    padded = jnp.pad(signals, ((0, 0), (half, half)))
    padded_sq = padded * padded
    starts = jnp.arange(0, length, tile)

    def process(start):
        width = jnp.minimum(tile, length - start)
        x = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(padded, (0, start), (signals.shape[0], tile + 2 * half))
        x2 = jax.lax.dynamic_slice(padded_sq, (0, start), (signals.shape[0], tile + 2 * half))
        p = jnp.concatenate((jnp.zeros((signals.shape[0], 1), signals.dtype), jnp.cumsum(x, axis=1)), axis=1)

        offsets = jnp.arange(tile) + half

        std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(squares - means * means, 0.0) + 1e-6)

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

from jax import lax

def candidate(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    radius = window // 2
    kernel = jnp.ones((window, 1, 1), dtype=signals.dtype)
    x = signals[:, :, None]
    sums = lax.conv_general_dilated(
        x, kernel, window_strides=(1,), padding="SAME",
        dimension_numbers=("NWC", "WIO", "NWC"),
    )[:, :, 0]
    square_sums = lax.conv_general_dilated(
        (signals ** 2)[:, :, None], kernel, window_strides=(1,), padding="SAME",
        dimension_numbers=("NWC", "WIO", "NWC"),
    )[:, :, 0]
    positions = jnp.arange(length)
    counts = jnp.minimum(positions + 1, radius + 1) + jnp.minimum(length - positions, radius)
    # For an odd window, SAME convolution uses radius elements on each side;
    # truncate the count at either boundary.
    counts = jnp.minimum(counts, window).astype(signals.dtype)
    local_mean = sums / counts[None, :]
    local_square = square_sums / counts[None, :]
    local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean ** 2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
    standardized = (signals - local_mean) / local_std
    peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return standardized / peak

def local_standardize(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    index = jnp.arange(length)
    band = (jnp.abs(index[:, None] - index[None, :]) <= window // 2).astype(signals.dtype)
    counts = jnp.sum(band, axis=0)
    rows = []
    for signal in signals:
        local_mean = signal @ band / counts
        local_square = (signal**2) @ band / counts
        local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean**2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
        standardized = (signal - local_mean) / local_std
        peak = jnp.sort(jnp.abs(standardized))[-1]
        rows.append(standardized / peak)
    return jnp.stack(rows)

def candidate(signals):
    length = signals.shape[-1]
    window = 33
    radius = window // 2
    kernel = jnp.ones((window, 1, 1), dtype=signals.dtype)
    x = signals[:, :, None]
    sums = lax.conv_general_dilated(
        x, kernel, window_strides=(1,), padding="SAME",
        dimension_numbers=("NWC", "WIO", "NWC"),
    )[:, :, 0]
    square_sums = lax.conv_general_dilated(
        (signals ** 2)[:, :, None], kernel, window_strides=(1,), padding="SAME",
        dimension_numbers=("NWC", "WIO", "NWC"),
    )[:, :, 0]
    positions = jnp.arange(length)
    counts = jnp.minimum(positions + 1, radius + 1) + jnp.minimum(length - positions, radius)
    # For an odd window, SAME convolution uses radius elements on each side;

    counts = jnp.minimum(counts, window).astype(signals.dtype)
    local_mean = sums / counts[None, :]
    local_square = square_sums / counts[None, :]
    local_std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(local_square - local_mean ** 2, 0.0) + 1e-6)
    standardized = (signals - local_mean) / local_std
    peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(standardized), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return standardized / peak

def candidate(signals):
    n = signals.shape[-1]
    x = jnp.pad(signals, ((0, 0), (1, 0)))
    p = jnp.cumsum(x, axis=1)
    q = jnp.cumsum(x * x, axis=1)
    i = jnp.arange(n)
    lo = jnp.maximum(i - 16, 0)
    hi = jnp.minimum(i + 17, n)
    cnt = (hi - lo).astype(signals.dtype)
    mean = (jnp.take(p, hi, axis=1) - jnp.take(p, lo, axis=1)) / cnt
    sq = (jnp.take(q, hi, axis=1) - jnp.take(q, lo, axis=1)) / cnt
    std = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(sq - mean * mean, 0.0) + 1e-6)
    z = (signals - mean) / std
    peak = jnp.max(jnp.abs(z), axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return z / peak
